name: nginx-multisite
description: Provides Nginx multi-site web serving for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including security hardening, firewall and Fail2ban configuration, SSH restrictions, static content, and development certificate generation.

name: cache
description: Provisions Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging directory creation, service enablement, and Redis configuration management.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL dependencies, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application, creates its virtual environment and database, and runs it as a systemd service on port 8000.
